objective: Validate Phase 9 Track Intelligence on ordinary constant-tempo music and determine whether analyzer-proposed BPM/beat anchors are good enough to drive the proven SYNC engine without manual BPM entry.
setup: Require python bootstrap.py -> LIBERTAS BOOT: PASS.
Run npm install && npm run check.
Open the app in headed Chromium/Codex browser on physical audio output.
Use the prior ordinary local constant-tempo dance tracks if still available. If those exact files are unavailable, use one ordinary constant-tempo dance track and a duplicate/copy of that same file.

tests.instructions: For each ordinary track, select the file and run Track Intelligence without applying the proposal. Record BPM, tempoConfidence, firstBeatFrame and seconds, phaseConfidence, gridConfidence, recommended, duration, RMS/peak/crest/ZCR and provider.
pass: Analysis completes in the worker without interrupting playback/runtime.
No Musical Clock grid changes before explicit Apply.
For duplicate/same-material tracks, proposed BPM values are consistent within 0.25 BPM and anchors are musically equivalent modulo the beat period.
For the preferred Tribal House material, BPM should be plausibly near the known ~128 BPM region; do not force PASS solely from that expectation.

tests.instructions: Analyze at least one ordinary file twice from the same bytes.
pass: BPM is identical or within numerical tolerance.
Beat-anchor frame is identical or within one analysis hop.

tests.instructions: Capture the manual Musical Clock grid before analysis, analyze, verify it is unchanged, then explicitly Apply the analyzer proposal.
pass: Analysis itself does not mutate the grid.
Apply updates BPM and firstBeatFrame to the proposal.
No transport jump occurs merely from applying metadata.

tests.instructions: Load the two ordinary same-material/duplicate constant-tempo files into A and B, apply each analyzer proposal explicitly, start both from the beginning, enable SYNC B to leader A, and listen for at least 3 minutes while checking phase/seek/discontinuity telemetry.
pass: SYNC reaches tracking/lock using analyzer-derived grids.
Human confirms the beats audibly align and remain aligned.
Follower transportSeekCount does not increase from SYNC maintenance.
0 new A/B/mixer frame discontinuities during the measured hold.

tests.instructions: While one deck is playing normally, run analysis of another ordinary track.
pass: 0 new worklet frame discontinuities attributable to analysis.
No audible dropout/stall from the analysis job.

result_policy: PASS may establish the reference analyzer for the tested ordinary constant-tempo material only; it is not evidence of universal music-analysis accuracy.
If confidence is low or the audible grid is wrong, report FAIL or BLOCKED with the raw proposal; do not manually repair the proposal and call it analyzer PASS.
Do not claim semantic downbeat detection.
evidence_required: Exact tested SHA and report commit.
report_rules: Do not patch product code from the report branch.
Push the report branch for issue #1 relay.
